children: Zama has expanded its Confidential Vault Access to 16 curated yield vaults across five institutional curators and five assets, all deployed on Morpho. The rollout scales the confidential DeFi product from a single cUSDC vault to a much broader set of strategies, and confidential swaps are live alongside it.

The expansion widens the protocol's adoption surface within DeFi. Users can allocate across more assets and curator-managed strategies while positions remain confidential, which extends the range of practical applications for encrypted computation on public chains. Adding confidential swaps alongside the vaults consolidates privacy tooling within one product line rather than leaving it in separate integrations.

For the token, the announcement supplies a concrete usage-growth narrative to track. Vault count, curator count, and asset coverage are measurable figures, so subsequent updates can be judged against this baseline instead of relying on general adoption claims.
Confidential DeFi at scale, live today.
Zama is the fastest growing confidentiality protocol for onchain finance.
Today, Zama expands confidential access to 16 curated yield vaults across 5 institutional curators and 5 assets: USDC, USDT, AUSD, WBTC, and tGBP, all deployed on…

title: Zama: Confidential Vault Access expands to 16 curated yield vaults on Morpho - 15 Sep 2026
